summary.value: Spires of jagged rock erupt from the ground beneath your foes, closing around them.

system.description: Spires of jagged rock erupt from the ground beneath your foes, closing around them. You deal (HR + 15) earth damage to each target hit by this spell. This spell cannot target creatures that are flying, floating, falling, or otherwise in mid-air. Opportunity: each target hit by this spell performs one fewer action on their next turn (to a minimum of 0 actions).
